title: Apply relative refractive index

hook.scenario: Pehle humne light ko hawa (air) se glass mein bheja. Par agar light pehle se hi paani mein ho aur wahan se glass mein jaaye, tab kitna mudegi?
hook.question: Do alag-alag materials (air ke bina) ke beech light ki bending ko kaise compare karte hain?

mental_model.intuition: Relative index = Destination ki speed-braking power / Source ki speed-braking power.
mental_model.description: Jab light medium 1 se medium 2 mein jati hai, toh hum Relative Refractive Index (n21) nikalte hain. n21 ka matlab hai ki pehle wale medium ke comparison mein doosra medium kitna ghana hai. Iska formula speed aur absolute index dono se banta hai.

explanation:
Absolute refractive index (n) humesha vacuum (ya hawa) ke reference mein hota hai. Par kya hoga agar light water (medium 1) se glass (medium 2) mein travel kare?

Aisi situation mein hum 'Relative Refractive Index' nikalte hain, jise hum n21 (Refractive index of medium 2 with respect to medium 1) likhte hain. Ise nikalne ke do tareeqe hain:

1. Speeds ke zariye: n21 = (Speed of light in medium 1) / (Speed of light in medium 2) = v1 / v2. Dhyan do, medium 1 upar hai aur medium 2 neeche.

2. Absolute refractive index ke zariye: n21 = n2 / n1. Yahan medium 2 ka apna absolute index upar hota hai aur medium 1 ka neeche. Yeh bohot commonly use hota hai.

Agar aap n12 nikalna chaho (Refractive index of medium 1 with respect to medium 2), toh woh n21 ka exactly ulta (reciprocal) hota hai. Yani n12 = 1 / n21. Yeh formula MCQs solve karne ke liye trick jaisa kaam karta hai.

key_points.title: Speed Formula
key_points.detail: n21 = v1 / v2. (Speed in medium 1 over speed in medium 2)

key_points.title: Index Formula
key_points.detail: n21 = n2 / n1. (Absolute index of medium 2 over absolute index of medium 1)

worked_example.problem: Light travels from water (medium 1, v1 = 2.25 × 10^8 m/s) to glass (medium 2, v2 = 2 × 10^8 m/s). What is the refractive index of glass with respect to water (n21)?

steps.narration: Relative index aur speed ka formula use karein.

worked_example.problem: Refractive index of glass is 1.5 (n_g) and water is 1.33 (n_w). What is the refractive index of glass with respect to water?

steps.narration: Relative index ko absolute indices se jodne wala formula lagayein.

common_mistakes.title: Flipping the numerator and denominator
common_mistakes.explanation: Sabse badi galti yeh hoti hai ki bacche n21 mein v2/v1 kar dete hain. Yaad rakho: n21 mein absolute 'n' ka ratio n2/n1 hota hai, par velocities mein ye ulta hota hai: v1/v2.

recall_questions.q: What is the formula for refractive index of medium 2 with respect to medium 1 (n21) in terms of speeds v1 and v2?
What is the relation between n12 and n21?

recall_questions.answer: Refractive index of medium 2 with respect to medium 1.

oa_questions.question: The refractive index of water with respect to air is 4/3 and that of glass with respect to air is 3/2. Find the refractive index of glass with respect to water.
If n21 = 1.5, what is the value of n12?
oa_questions.approach: Use the property that n12 is the reciprocal of n21.
